faqs.answer: We provide full-service web development that is tailored to your business needs. Examples of the types of services we provide are custom design & development, CMS integration, e-commerce, Search Engine Optimization, cloud hosting, and AI features.

points.text: We create custom designs that are unique and fun and reflect your branding.
We design a responsive frontend and deliver a backend that works.
We develop a safe and secure e-commerce store with payment processing, inventory, and user experience.
We use WordPress, Shopify, and other easy-to-use CMS that is easy to manage your content with.
We build your site search engine optimized and performance optimized to grow traffic and improve user experience.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build my website?
faqs.answer: The timelines for each plan may vary based on complexity. A standard website project will typically be done in 4–6 weeks, while a more complicated website project could take up to 8–12 weeks. We work step by step to produce our work on time and to a high-quality standard.

points.text: We will spend time assessing your planned goals, features, and content to scope/assess how much work will be required for your project.
A basic website with a standard set of features is often done in this timeframe.
More advanced features, custom integrations, or large project plans may take larger amounts of time.
During the first month, we will be laying out all of the planned user experience and will adapt with your feedback along the way to deliver what we have planned together in the best order and flow.
Testing and quality assurance involve thoroughly testing your website to identify bugs, test browser and device compatibility, and performance testing.
Once your project has been delivered, we can assist you with ongoing maintenance, changes/fixes/updates, or further enhancements, depending on your needs.
